up: List all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5241054. For each compound, return the ChEMBL ID (chembl_id), the preferred name (pref_name), the maximum clinical phase (max_phase), the molecule type (molecule_type), and the canonical SMILES string (canonical_smiles). Order the results by the compound's ChEMBL ID.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, md.max_phase, md.molecule_type, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5241054' ORDER BY md.chembl_id
